title: DHIS2 Clinic Selector
description: A switcher for the clinic a user is working in: a short list of their own organisation units, with search when they have more.
docs: Wrap the app in ClinicProvider and put ClinicSelector in a SidebarHeader directly under Sidebar, before SidebarNavigation, which is hidden while collapsed. The block does not depend on the sidebar, so pass collapsed={useSidebar().state.collapsed} yourself. Read useClinic() on any page to scope its data to the current clinic. Pass value and onValueChange to ClinicProvider to control the choice, for example from the URL. Set label and searchPlaceholder when your users call clinics facilities or sites. For a tree picker of any organisation unit, use context-selector instead.
